item.title: Inside Grantham’s White House
item.description: VERY few pre-Georgian stone houses survive in Grantham, the White House, Brownlow Street, is an exception. Yet this gem is often overlooked as motorists concentrate on their lane discipline. Inside, there is a surprise around every corner, from Queen Ann panelling to an Adam fireplace – as well as a 17th Century one. item.title: Cannabis plants found at Grantham property
item.description: Cannabis has been found in five rooms at a property in Great Ponton. Officers discovered the plants at an address on Heath Lane on Friday, 27 February. A 41-year-old man has been arrested on suspicion of cultivating cannabis. Investigations continue and if you can provide any further information, please contact PC 1036 Burley on Jessica.Burley2@lincs.police.uk […] The post Cannabis plants found at Grantham property appeared first on Grantham Matters.

item.title: No tax, no insurance, no MoT – no laughing matter!
item.description: Lincolnshire Police Specialist Operations took a punt on stopping this vehicle in Great Gonerby. It had no insurance, tax, or MOT, and the tyre had cord exposed. The driver was reported. The vehicle was prohibited and seized. Saying “I only use the back roads” is no excuse. The post No tax, no insurance, no MoT – no laughing matter! appeared first on Grantham Matters.
